top_story_headline: Compromised keys just passed smart-contract bugs as DeFi's top attack vector — $1.3B lost in 2026
top_story_comment: CertiK counted 204 code-bug incidents in H1, but 33 wallet compromises lost $444.5M versus $151.6M across those 204 bugs. Aave’s April 20 incident report shows the spillover: Kelp’s 1-of-1 LayerZero route left 89,567 rsETH posted against 82,650 WETH and 821 wstETH of attacker borrows.
